sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, Iran is warning that it may resume production on its nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 今天，伊朗警告称可能会恢复其核计划的生产。

sentences.en: Reviving a crisis that had been contained by the signing of the Iran nuclear deal four years ago.
sentences.zh: 这重新引发了一场四年前因签署伊朗核协议而得到遏制的危机。

sentences.en: How one man within the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国政府内部的一个人是如何

sentences.en: government may have intentionally brought us to this point.
sentences.zh: 可能蓄意将我们带到这一步的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: Mark Landler, tell me how we got to this point in the relationship between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 马克·兰德勒，请告诉我我们是如何走到美国与伊朗关系

sentences.en: and Iran.
sentences.zh: 这一步的。

sentences.en: Well, Michael, the story really starts almost exactly a year ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，这个故事实际上几乎正好始于一年前。

sentences.en: Today, I want to update the world on our efforts to prevent Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想向全世界通报我们为阻止伊朗获得核武器所做的努力。

sentences.en: When President Trump finally makes good on a pledge he had made during the 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统最终兑现他在2016年竞选期间做出的承诺时。

sentences.en: I am announcing today that the United States will withdraw from the Iran nuclear deal.
sentences.zh: 我今天宣布，美国将退出伊朗核协议。

sentences.en: Recall, the Iran nuclear deal was signed between Iran on the one side, the United States, and three European countries, Britain, France, and Germany.
sentences.zh: 回想一下，伊朗核协议是由伊朗、美国以及英国、法国和德国这三个欧洲国家签署的。

sentences.en: And the idea behind the deal was, in return for deferring whatever nuclear ambitions it had, Iran was going to be released from these very onerous sanctions that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 该协议背后的想法是，作为推迟其任何核野心的交换，伊朗将免除美国

sentences.en: and the international community had imposed on it.
sentences.zh: 和国际社会对其施加的非常繁重的制裁。

sentences.en: And as a result, was going to be able to build up the rest of its economy, even while accepting that its nuclear program was going to be hindered for this period of time,
sentences.zh: 因此，伊朗将能够重建其经济的其他部分，即使同时接受其核计划在这一时期内受到限制，

sentences.en: roughly 15 to 20 years.
sentences.zh: 大约15到20年。

sentences.en: Tonight, the breaking news, a major shakeup at the White House moments ago.
sentences.zh: 今晚的突发新闻，白宫刚刚发生了重大改组。

sentences.en: We are just learning.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚获悉。

sentences.en: At the same time that President Trump is making good on this campaign promise to pull the United States out of this deal, you have a new personality,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统兑现竞选承诺退出该协议的同时，你有一个新人物，

sentences.en: a new figure entering the White House.
sentences.zh: 一个新面孔进入了白宫。

sentences.en: National Security Advisor H.R.
sentences.zh: 国家安全顾问H.R.

sentences.en: McMaster is gone.
sentences.zh: 麦克马斯特离职了。

sentences.en: President Trump dismisses his former National Security Advisor, General H.R.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统解雇了他的前国家安全顾问、将军H.R.

sentences.en: McMaster, and McMaster is replaced by a man named John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 麦克马斯特，接替麦克马斯特的是一个名叫约翰·博尔顿的人。

sentences.en: And what is significant about these two things, pulling out of the Iran deal and appointing John Bolton, happening at the same time, roughly?
sentences.zh: 这两件事——退出伊朗协议和任命约翰·博尔顿——几乎同时发生，其意义何在？

sentences.en: Well, for one thing, it puts Iran on a collision course with the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，这使伊朗与美国走上了冲突的道路。

sentences.en: You have the jeopardizing of this deal, which itself had resolved more than a decade of confrontation between Iran and the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 你危及了这项协议，而该协议本身已经解决了伊朗与西方之间十多年的对抗。

sentences.en: The Iran deal was, in fact, the worst diplomatic debacle in American history.
sentences.zh: 伊朗协议实际上是美国历史上最糟糕的外交惨败。

sentences.en: The importance of John Bolton's arrival is that now you have an official in the middle of the policymaking mix who has perhaps the hardest-line record toward Iran of any senior figure in the mainstream foreign policy community.
sentences.zh: 约翰·博尔顿到来的重要性在于，现在决策核心中出现了一位官员，他在主流外交政策界中对伊朗的态度可能是所有高级人物中最强硬的。

sentences.en: If you cross us, our allies or our partners, if you harm our citizens, if you continue to lie, cheat, and deceive, yes, there will indeed be hell to pay.
sentences.zh: 如果你冒犯我们、我们的盟友或我们的伙伴，如果你伤害我们的公民，如果你继续撒谎、欺骗和蒙蔽，是的，确实会有严重的后果。

sentences.en: And John Bolton comes at Iran from a very different place than Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而约翰·博尔顿对待伊朗的立场与唐纳德·特朗普截然不同。

sentences.en: Where they differ is really what the ultimate objective is.
sentences.zh: 他们的分歧实际上在于最终目标是什么。

sentences.en: For Trump, he's willing to sit down and talk to the existing leadership in pursuit of a better deal.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普来说，他愿意坐下来与现任领导层对话，以寻求达成更好的协议。

sentences.en: Look, the president has said since really beginning in the 2016 campaign that he's open to negotiating with leaders like Rouhani, like with Kim Jong-un, to sit down with them.
sentences.zh: 看，总统从2016年竞选开始就一直说，他愿意与鲁哈尼这样的领导人，以及金正恩这样的领导人进行谈判，坐下来与他们交谈。

sentences.en: The Iranians have used negotiations in the path just to delay.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人过去利用谈判只是为了拖延时间。

sentences.en: For John Bolton, it's something much more fundamental.
sentences.zh: 对于约翰·博尔顿来说，这是更根本的事情。

sentences.en: He wants to install new democratic leaders in that country.
sentences.zh: 他想在那个国家扶植新的民主领导人。

sentences.en: He wants regime change.
sentences.zh: 他想要政权更迭。

sentences.en: We should provide material financial support to the opposition if they desire it.
sentences.zh: 如果反对派有需要，我们应该向他们提供物质和财政支持。

sentences.en: We should work with intelligence services from other countries, Saudi, Israel, to provide more pressure.
sentences.zh: 我们应该与其他国家的安全情报部门，如沙特、以色列合作，施加更大的压力。

sentences.en: There's a lot we can do, and we should do it.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做很多事情，而且我们应该去做。

sentences.en: Our goal should be regime change in Iran.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标应该是伊朗的政权更迭。

sentences.en: So regime change as a concept has been a part of American foreign policy really since World War II.
sentences.zh: 所以，政权更迭作为一个概念，实际上自二战以来一直是美国外交政策的一部分。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has always debated the wisdom of trying to take out or roll back enemy or adversarial governments.
sentences.zh: 一直在争论试图推翻或削弱敌对政府是否明智。

sentences.en: But what happened in the last 15 years is the phrase regime change became identified with the Iraq War, a war that was far more costly, far longer,
sentences.zh: 但在过去15年里发生的事情是，“政权更迭”这个词与伊拉克战争联系在了一起，那场战争比布什政府预想的要昂贵得多、漫长得多，

sentences.en: far more trouble-prone than the Bush administration ever hoped.
sentences.zh: 也麻烦得多。

sentences.en: And I think ever since that experience and those difficult days, the idea of regime change has simply become toxic to a large portion of the foreign policy community,
sentences.zh: 我认为，自那次经历和那些艰难的日子以来，政权更迭的想法对很大一部分外交政策界来说已经变得有毒，

sentences.en: but also the political class, both Republican and Democrat.
sentences.zh: 对共和党和民主党的政治阶层来说也是如此。

sentences.en: When people say the words regime change, people think about Iraq.
sentences.zh: 当人们说“政权更迭”时，人们会想到伊拉克。

sentences.en: Hence, no one wants to say those words.
sentences.zh: 因此，没有人愿意说这些词。

sentences.en: And so the combination of the jeopardizing of the deal and John Bolton is a very combustible mixture.
sentences.zh: 所以，危及协议与约翰·博尔顿的结合是一个非常易燃的混合体。

sentences.en: And what is Bolton's argument for this focus on regime change in Iran?
sentences.zh: 那么博尔顿关注伊朗政权更迭的论点是什么？

sentences.en: Bolton's argument is that the Iranian regime is the world's largest financier of international terrorism.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿的论点是，伊朗政权是世界上最大的国际恐怖主义资助者。

sentences.en: The world's largest state sponsor of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 世界上最大的国家级恐怖主义支持者。

sentences.en: It continues to pursue ballistic missiles.
sentences.zh: 它继续追求弹道导弹。

sentences.en: A potential nuclear proliferator on a grand scale.
sentences.zh: 一个潜在的大规模核扩散者。

sentences.en: The only real purpose of which is to deliver nuclear weapons when they get that capability.
sentences.zh: 其唯一真正的目的就是在获得能力后运载核武器。

sentences.en: A malign influence in the region, fomenting unrest, financing militant groups in Syria, in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 该地区的一种恶性影响，煽动动乱，资助叙利亚和也门的激进组织。

sentences.en: There's no doubt this regime is a threat in the region globally.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这个政权是该地区乃至全球的一个威胁。

sentences.en: A country that is bent on the destruction of the state of Israel, a great American ally.
sentences.zh: 一个一心想要摧毁美国伟大盟友以色列国的国家。

sentences.en: So he really believes that much of the ills that afflict the Middle East can be laid at Tehran's doorstep.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实认为中东地区的大部分弊病都可以归咎于德黑兰。

sentences.en: That the Tehran regime is the central problem in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 德黑兰政权是中东问题的核心。

sentences.en: And that hence the only answer, the only way to bring Iran back into the community of civilized nations is to affect a change in leadership.
sentences.zh: 因此，唯一的答案，让伊朗重返文明国家行列的唯一途径，就是实现领导层的更迭。

sentences.en: So basically, people so terrible that they can't possibly be trusted to negotiate a nuclear deal.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这些人太糟糕了，以至于根本不能信任他们去谈判核协议。

sentences.en: In a word, yes.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，是的。

sentences.en: And how does Bolton begin to set that goal in motion?
sentences.zh: 那么博尔顿是如何开始推动这一目标的呢？

sentences.en: At the stroke of midnight, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 午夜钟声敲响时，美国

sentences.en: will reimpose stiff economic sanctions on Iran.
sentences.zh: 将对伊朗重新实施严厉的经济制裁。

sentences.en: Well, the first thing he does is he reimposes the sanctions that had been lifting as a consequence of the deal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他做的第一件事就是重新实施那些因协议而解除的制裁。

sentences.en: The sanctions target Iran's gold and metal industries, its auto sector, and restrict Iran from using U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些制裁针对伊朗的黄金和金属工业、汽车行业，并限制伊朗使用美元

sentences.en: dollars in financial transactions.
sentences.zh: 进行金融交易。

sentences.en: And his goal here is to squeeze the vice around the Iranian economy, to raise the pain threshold for the Iranian government, so that, in effect, they're forced to knuckle under,
sentences.zh: 他的目标是收紧对伊朗经济的钳制，提高伊朗政府的痛苦阈值，从而迫使他们屈服，

sentences.en: to come back to the table, to acknowledge that they're willing to swallow a less advantageous deal.
sentences.zh: 回到谈判桌前，承认他们愿意接受一份不那么有利的协议。

sentences.en: And I think we've already seen the consequences in Iran.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们已经在伊朗看到了后果。

sentences.en: The real, the currency, has declined by 70 percent since the sanctions.
sentences.zh: 自制裁以来，里亚尔货币贬值了70%。

sentences.en: Inflation has quadrupled.
sentences.zh: 通货膨胀率翻了两番。

sentences.en: The country is in recession.
sentences.zh: 国家处于衰退之中。

sentences.en: I think this is going to cut into Iran's ability to continue their nuclear program, to finance terrorism, and to engage in military activity around the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将削弱伊朗继续其核计划、资助恐怖主义以及在中东进行军事活动的能力。

sentences.en: So the goal here is to make the Iranian government so frustrated with this situation that they just throw up their hands and walk away from the entire nuclear deal.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的目标是让伊朗政府对这种情况感到如此沮丧，以至于他们干脆放弃，退出整个核协议。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But the Iranians do something unexpected.
sentences.zh: 但伊朗人做了一些意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: Rather than pull out of the deal themselves, they decide to stay in it.
sentences.zh: 他们没有自己退出协议，而是决定留在协议中。

sentences.en: And they do that for a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做有几个原因。

sentences.en: One is that the European signatories of the deal, Britain, France, and Germany, all pledge to stay in the deal.
sentences.zh: 一是协议的欧洲签署国英国、法国和德国都承诺留在协议中。

sentences.en: So the Iranians hope that even if they're cut off from all contact with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以伊朗人希望，即使他们被切断了与美国经济的所有联系，

sentences.en: economy, they can continue to do some level of trading with the Europeans.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然可以继续与欧洲人进行一定程度的贸易。

sentences.en: And secondly, they make this calculation that Donald Trump is a one-term president and that if they simply wait him out, perhaps he will be replaced by a friendlier successor,
sentences.zh: 其次，他们计算出唐纳德·特朗普是一个任期总统，如果他们只是等待他下台，也许他会被一位更友好的继任者取代，

sentences.en: perhaps another Democrat.
sentences.zh: 也许是另一位民主党人。

sentences.en: Most Democrats are on the record as saying they would reinstate the Iran nuclear deal.
sentences.zh: 大多数民主党人都公开表示他们会恢复伊朗核协议。

sentences.en: So there is this belief in Tehran, and it's encouraged, by the way, by both European officials and by some people here in the United States, that they should sit tight,
sentences.zh: 因此，德黑兰有一种信念，顺便说一句，这种信念也受到欧洲官员和美国一些人的鼓励，那就是他们应该坚持住，

sentences.en: don't rip up the deal, and see if they can wait out Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 不要撕毁协议，看看能否熬过唐纳德·特朗普的任期。

sentences.en: So once Iran has decided to basically wait out the Trump presidency, how does the Trump administration respond to what is clearly an act of defiance by Iran?
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦伊朗决定基本上熬过特朗普总统任期，特朗普政府对伊朗这种明显的反抗行为作何反应？

sentences.en: Well, what the Trump administration does publicly is it imposes enormous pressure on the Europeans to fall in line.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普政府公开所做的是向欧洲人施加巨大压力，要求他们保持一致。

sentences.en: Any nation that helps Iran in its quest for nuclear weapons could also be strongly sanctioned by the United States.
sentences.zh: 任何帮助伊朗寻求核武器的国家也可能受到美国的严厉制裁。

sentences.en: To start cutting off links to the Iranian government.
sentences.zh: 开始切断与伊朗政府的联系。

sentences.en: Whether it's the German manufacturer Siemens, the Danish shipping company Maersk, the French carmaker PSA, or the French energy giant Total,
sentences.zh: 无论是德国制造商西门子、丹麦航运公司马士基、法国汽车制造商标致雪铁龙，还是法国能源巨头道达尔，

sentences.en: all of these companies have decided to either scale down or completely pull out of Iran from fear of U.S.
sentences.zh: 所有这些公司都因为担心美国的制裁而决定缩减或完全撤出伊朗。

sentences.en: sanctions.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是特朗普政府所做的公开的一面。

sentences.en: So that's the public side of what the Trump administration is doing.
sentences.zh: 但在私下里，约翰·博尔顿确实在国家安全委员会内建立他的伊朗团队。

sentences.en: But privately, John Bolton is really building up his Iran cadre within the National Security Council.
sentences.zh: 他通过引入这些在制裁策略方面是专家的极端强硬派人物来做到这一点。

sentences.en: And he's doing so by bringing in these extremely hardline figures who are experts in sanction strategy.
sentences.zh: 他开始为压力运动的下一阶段奠定基础。

sentences.en: And he's beginning to lay in place the pieces for sort of the next phase of the pressure campaign.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 我在这里发表一项关于伊朗伊斯兰共和国的重要外交政策声明。

sentences.en: I'm here to make an important foreign policy announcement concerning the Islamic Republic of Iran.
sentences.zh: 在他开始探索并为其奠定基础的事情中，包括：

sentences.en: And among the things that he begins exploring and laying the groundwork for.
sentences.zh: 我宣布我们打算将伊斯兰革命卫队定性为……

sentences.en: I am announcing our intent to designate the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
sentences.zh: 将伊斯兰革命卫队，也就是伊朗领导层的军事分支，定性为伊斯兰革命卫队，

sentences.en: Are designating the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, which is this sort of military wing of the Iranian leadership, designating the IRGC.
sentences.zh: 列为外国恐怖组织。

sentences.en: As a foreign terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 列为外国恐怖组织。

sentences.en: As a foreign terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 这是华盛顿首次正式将另一个国家的军队分支标记为恐怖组织。

sentences.en: This is the first time Washington has formally labeled an arm of another country's military as a terrorist group.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府称，伊朗军队积极参与、资助并推动恐怖主义，将其作为治国的工具。

sentences.en: The Trump administration says the Iranian force actively participates in, finances, and promotes terrorism as a tool of statecraft.
sentences.zh: 那么，就博尔顿在此处的最终目标而言，这有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: And what would be the significance of that in terms of Bolton's ultimate goal here?
sentences.zh: 嗯，针对伊斯兰革命卫队不仅阻碍了伊朗在该地区投射恶性影响的能力，

sentences.en: Well, going after the IRGC not only hinders Iran's ability to project malign influence around the region.
sentences.zh: 它还打击了伊朗政治关联领导人的一个非常重要的收入来源。

sentences.en: It also hits at a very important source of revenue for politically connected leaders in Iran.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰革命卫队实际上是伊朗许多领导人中饱私囊的工具。

sentences.en: The IRGC is in fact the vehicle by which a lot of Iran's leadership enriches themselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，针对该组织既损害了伊朗国内，也损害了其在国际上运作的能力。

sentences.en: So going after that group both hurts Iran domestically and hurts its ability to operate internationally.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿还开始为对伊朗石油工业实施更严厉的制裁奠定基础。

sentences.en: Bolton also begins laying the groundwork for an even more draconian set of sanctions on Iran's oil industry.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，美国

sentences.en: Up until this point, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 允许一些国家，其中一些是美国的盟友，且非常依赖伊朗石油，在一段临时时期内继续从伊朗购买。

sentences.en: had allowed countries, some of whom are U.S.
sentences.zh: 但现在发生的事情是，政府撤销了这些豁免。

sentences.en: allies, and are very dependent on Iranian oil, to continue to buy from Iran for some temporary period of time.
sentences.zh: 八个国家将受到影响。

sentences.en: But what happens now is that the administration revokes those waivers.
sentences.zh: 它基本上告诉所有这些国家：中国、日本、韩国、土耳其、希腊、印度和意大利，

sentences.en: Eight countries will be affected.
sentences.zh: 任何想要避免被美国列入黑名单的国家都不能继续从伊朗购买石油。

sentences.en: It basically says to all of these countries, China, Japan, South Korea, Turkey, Greece, India, and Italy,
sentences.zh: 他们要么合作，要么面临制裁。

sentences.en: that no country that wants to avoid itself being blacklisted by the United States can continue to buy oil from Iran.
sentences.zh: 这一举措的影响对伊朗石油工业来说确实是毁灭性的，因为它当时已经在勉强维持，

sentences.en: And they either have to cooperate or face sanctions.
sentences.zh: 继续向这些在豁免下运作的国家出口一定数量的石油。

sentences.en: And the effect of this step is truly devastating to the Iranian oil industry because it was kind of limping along,
sentences.zh: 但一旦这些豁免消失，伊朗所有的客户基本上都被置于这样一种境地：我们不能再从你这里购买石油了。

sentences.en: continuing to export a certain amount of oil to these countries that were operating under waivers.
sentences.zh: 由于石油对伊朗经济至关重要，这在经济上等同于扼杀它。

sentences.en: But once these waivers are gone, truly all of Iran's customers are basically put in a position of saying, we cannot buy oil from you anymore.
sentences.zh: 它确实是伊朗经济的经济生命线。

sentences.en: And because oil is so central to Iran's economy, that is the economical equivalent of just kind of strangling it.
sentences.zh: 所以将其100%切断确实产生了毁灭性的影响。

sentences.en: It really is the economic lifeline of the Iranian economy.
sentences.zh: 自今年年初以来，其货币里亚尔兑美元已经贬值了三分之二。

sentences.en: And so cutting it off 100 percent just has a truly devastating effect.
sentences.zh: 国际货币基金组织表示，伊朗经济今年将萎缩6%，而那还是在最新的美国

sentences.en: Its currency, the rial, has already lost two-thirds of its value against the dollar since the year began.
sentences.zh: 行动之前。

sentences.en: The IMF said the Iranian economy would shrink 6 percent this year, and that was before the latest U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是一种压力水平。

sentences.en: moves.
sentences.zh: 这是一种经济钳制的收紧，是伊朗人迄今为止从未经历过的。

sentences.en: This is a level of pressure.
sentences.zh: 但它究竟是如何实现博尔顿的政权更迭目标的呢？

sentences.en: This is a tightening of the economic vice, unlike anything the Iranians have so far experienced.
sentences.zh: 这确实是经济上的生命线。

sentences.en: But how exactly does it get to Bolton's goal of regime change?
sentences.zh: 所以切断它百分之百确实有毁灭性的影响。

sentences.en: Well, one school of thought is that if you reduce Iran's oil exports to zero, you crater its currency, you tank its economy, and you throw millions of Iranian people into poverty,
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为，如果将伊朗的石油出口削减至零，就能摧毁其货币，重创其经济，并使数百万伊朗民众陷入贫困，

sentences.en: you could in fact spark the kind of uprising that people like John Bolton have been waiting for for a quarter century,
sentences.zh: 实际上，这可能会引发像约翰·博尔顿这样的人期待了四分之一个世纪的那种起义，

sentences.en: an uprising that would actually topple the regime from inside.
sentences.zh: 一场真正能从内部推翻该政权的起义。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So the idea is that you squeeze Iran hard enough that the regular people of Iran rise up and oust the regime,
sentences.zh: 所以，其核心思路是：对伊朗施加足够的压力，让伊朗普通民众奋起反抗，推翻现政权，

sentences.en: which is a little bit different than I think how most people think of regime change.
sentences.zh: 这与大多数人理解的“政权更迭”略有不同。

sentences.en: If you remember Iraq, regime change was the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得伊拉克战争，那时的政权更迭是由美国

sentences.en: invading.
sentences.zh: 通过入侵实现的。

sentences.en: Here, it's making the people in that country so miserable in a way that they decide to take out their own leaders.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，是通过让该国人民生活在极度痛苦中，从而促使他们决定除掉自己的领导人。

sentences.en: And it's driven by a couple of different things.
sentences.zh: 这背后有几个不同的驱动因素。

sentences.en: One is that unlike Iraq, invading Iran would be a monumentally difficult undertaking.
sentences.zh: 首先，与伊拉克不同，入侵伊朗将是一项极其艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: So the notion of an American invasion of Iran is really not on the table.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国入侵伊朗的想法实际上并不在考虑范围内。

sentences.en: This is more about can we make life miserable enough that we can actually bring about regime change from internally.
sentences.zh: 现在的重点在于，我们能否通过让他们的生活变得足够艰难，从而实现从内部引发政权更迭。

sentences.en: To the degree that the administration is behind Bolton's strategy right now, which it seems it is,
sentences.zh: 就目前政府对博尔顿战略的支持程度来看，似乎确实如此，

sentences.en: are there signs that it's actually working, that the Iranian regime is starting to collapse from within as it's supposed to?
sentences.zh: 那么，是否有迹象表明这真的奏效了？伊朗政权是否正如预期的那样开始从内部瓦解？

sentences.en: I think the short answer to that is no.
sentences.zh: 我认为简短的回答是：没有。

sentences.en: There is no question that the sanctions have really hurt the Iranian economy, have devastated its oil exports.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，制裁确实重创了伊朗经济，摧毁了其石油出口。

sentences.en: But in the main, this is a regime that seems as firmly entrenched as ever.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，这个政权看起来依然根深蒂固。

sentences.en: And it's also a regime that is still able to exert influence around the region.
sentences.zh: 而且，它依然有能力在该地区施加影响力。

sentences.en: It continues to be active in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 它在黎巴嫩依然活跃。

sentences.en: It continues to be active in Syria.
sentences.zh: 它在叙利亚依然活跃。

sentences.en: It continues to have a role to play in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 它在也门依然发挥着作用。

sentences.en: So the answer to that is no.
sentences.zh: 所以，答案是否定的。

sentences.en: Neither internally nor in its neighborhood is there evidence that the Trump administration is really jeopardizing the survival of the regime.
sentences.zh: 无论是从内部还是周边地区来看，都没有证据表明特朗普政府真的威胁到了该政权的生存。

sentences.en: And yet this week...
sentences.zh: 然而就在本周……

sentences.en: We've got some breaking news just coming across the wire out of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚收到来自中东的突发新闻。

sentences.en: We finally did see some signs that Iran is growing impatient.
sentences.zh: 我们终于看到了一些伊朗失去耐心的迹象。

sentences.en: One year to the day after President Trump withdrew the United States from the landmark Iran nuclear agreement,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统宣布美国退出具有里程碑意义的伊朗核协议一周年之际，

sentences.en: Iranian President Hassan Rouhani says he has sent letters to the remaining signatories of the deal saying...
sentences.zh: 伊朗总统哈桑·鲁哈尼表示，他已致信协议的其他签署国，称……

sentences.en: Iran's President Hassan Rouhani announced that Iran would begin to pull away in a modest way from parts of the Iranian nuclear deal.
sentences.zh: 伊朗总统哈桑·鲁哈尼宣布，伊朗将开始适度退出伊朗核协议的部分条款。

sentences.en: They would begin some very small-scale enrichment of nuclear material.
sentences.zh: 他们将开始小规模的核材料浓缩活动。

sentences.en: So they're not violating the deal in any dramatic fashion, but they're beginning to peel away from the edges of the deal.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们并没有以激进的方式违反协议，但他们开始从协议的边缘逐步撤出。

sentences.en: And perhaps more significantly, they're putting the Europeans in a box.
sentences.zh: 或许更重要的是，他们把欧洲人逼到了死角。

sentences.en: Iran says other countries have two months to implement their commitments to the deal, or Iran will, quote, reduce its own.
sentences.zh: 伊朗表示，其他国家有两个月的时间来履行协议承诺，否则伊朗将“缩减”自己的承诺。

sentences.en: So remember, the Europeans pledged to stay in the deal.
sentences.zh: 请记住，欧洲人曾承诺留在协议中。

sentences.en: They pledged to continue to give Iran the benefits of the deal, even if the United States pulled out.
sentences.zh: 他们承诺即使美国退出，也会继续让伊朗享受协议带来的利益。

sentences.en: And essentially what the Iranian government said to the Europeans this week is, you have a certain period of time to show us that we are going to get these economic benefits.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗政府本周对欧洲人说的话，本质上是：你们只有一段时间来向我们证明，我们确实能获得这些经济利益。

sentences.en: And if you can't show us, then we're going to pull out of the deal in a much more wholesale fashion.
sentences.zh: 如果你们做不到，那么我们将以更彻底的方式退出协议。

sentences.en: The Iranian president says the country will start enriching uranium again in 60 days.
sentences.zh: 伊朗总统表示，该国将在60天后重新开始浓缩铀。

sentences.en: That's unless Europe, Russia and China can help Iran counter U.S.
sentences.zh: 除非欧洲、俄罗斯和中国能帮助伊朗抵御美国

sentences.en: sanctions on its oil sales.
sentences.zh: 对其石油销售的制裁。

sentences.en: So in effect, what they've done is they've put the Europeans in the middle of their evolving battle with the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，他们已经把欧洲人卷入了他们与美国不断升级的博弈之中。

sentences.en: And kind of encouraged them to choose between Iran and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并变相鼓励他们在伊朗和美国之间做出选择。

sentences.en: And it's a very difficult choice.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常艰难的选择。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, the Europeans can defy President Trump and say, we're going to continue to do business with the Iranians,
sentences.zh: 一方面，欧洲人可以无视特朗普总统，说：我们将继续与伊朗做生意，

sentences.en: in which case the president could theoretically say, fine, I'm going to sanction you.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，总统理论上可以说：好吧，那我就制裁你们。

sentences.en: On the other hand, if the Europeans say to the Iranians, we can't afford to defy the United States,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果欧洲人对伊朗人说：我们无法承受无视美国的后果，

sentences.en: then Iran could say, in that case, we have a pretext, a reasonable case for leaving this deal entirely,
sentences.zh: 那么伊朗就可以说：既然如此，我们就有了一个借口，一个完全退出该协议的合理理由，

sentences.en: which is something, of course, the Europeans have been desperately trying to avoid.
sentences.zh: 而这当然是欧洲人一直极力想要避免的。

sentences.en: So is this a sign that Bolton's plan is working?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是博尔顿计划奏效的迹象吗？

sentences.en: Or is it a sign that maybe it backfired?
sentences.zh: 还是说这反而适得其反了？

sentences.en: Well, it depends on your perspective.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这取决于你的立场。

sentences.en: From the perspective of someone who wants to keep Iran's nuclear program bottled up, it has totally backfired.
sentences.zh: 对于那些想要遏制伊朗核计划的人来说，这完全是适得其反。

sentences.en: From the perspective of someone who is hungry for a confrontation with Iran, it actually provides you with more of a rationale.
sentences.zh: 而对于那些渴望与伊朗对抗的人来说，这反而为你提供了更多的理由。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, in the sense that they're now in breach of the agreement.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们现在违反了协议。

sentences.en: Beforehand, the United States was imposing all this pressure on Iran without really having the legal high ground because the Iranians were complying with the terms of the deal.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，美国在没有占据道德制高点的情况下对伊朗施加了所有压力，因为伊朗人一直遵守协议条款。

sentences.en: The American argument was it's a terrible deal.
sentences.zh: 美国的论点是：这是一项糟糕的协议。

sentences.en: Now the Iranians are in breach of the deal.
sentences.zh: 现在，伊朗人违反了协议。

sentences.en: So it actually gives more of a pretext, more of a case for the Trump administration to tighten the vice on the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 所以，这实际上为特朗普政府进一步收紧对伊朗的制裁提供了更多的借口和理由。

sentences.en: So if you are somebody who favors regime change, not just going back to the negotiating table, this is a reasonably good place to be.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你是支持政权更迭，而不仅仅是想回到谈判桌的人，这算是一个相当有利的局面。

sentences.en: It's a better place to be because now you're dealing with a regime that has to some extent gone rogue, a regime that signed a deal with the international community,
sentences.zh: 这是一个更好的局面，因为现在你面对的是一个在某种程度上已经变得“流氓”的政权，一个曾与国际社会签署协议的政权，

sentences.en: which won a lot of credit in Europe for sticking to the terms of that deal, which won a lot of credit at the United Nations for sticking with the terms of that deal.
sentences.zh: 它因遵守协议条款而在欧洲赢得了不少赞誉，也因遵守条款而在联合国赢得了不少赞誉。

sentences.en: Well, now suddenly the Iranians are also in breach.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在伊朗人突然也违约了。

sentences.en: So I think it does improve your position if your goal is conflict rather than some kind of diplomatic resolution.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，如果你的目标是冲突而非某种外交解决方案，这确实改善了你的处境。

sentences.en: If you're John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 如果你是约翰·博尔顿的话。

sentences.en: If you're, in other words, John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果你是约翰·博尔顿。

sentences.en: Mark, it's one way to think about this, that John Bolton would never have signed the Iran deal in the first place as Obama did.
sentences.zh: 马克，有一种看法是，约翰·博尔顿当初根本就不会像奥巴马那样签署伊朗核协议。

sentences.en: So he's basically trying to get us right back where we were before that deal was signed, which is Iran developing a nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是想让我们回到协议签署前的状态，即伊朗正在发展核计划。

sentences.en: But this time, rather than solve it through a nuclear deal, he wants to solve it another way, regime change.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他不想通过核协议来解决，而是想用另一种方式：政权更迭。

sentences.en: I think that's right, because I think that John Bolton's argument is the way to forever guarantee that Iran doesn't develop a nuclear weapon
sentences.zh: 我认为是对的，因为我认为约翰·博尔顿的论点是：要永远保证伊朗不发展核武器，

sentences.en: is not to put on these complicated timelines that expire at some point in the future, but to fundamentally change the character of the government in Iran.
sentences.zh: 不是设定这些在未来某个时间点就会过期的复杂时间表，而是从根本上改变伊朗政府的性质。

sentences.en: So you just don't have to worry about this nuclear threat at all.
sentences.zh: 这样你就根本不必担心核威胁了。

sentences.en: And trying to achieve it through arrangements, through complicated treaties, is simply never going to work because of the nature of the leadership you're dealing with.
sentences.zh: 而且，试图通过安排、通过复杂的条约来实现这一目标，由于你所面对的领导层的本质，注定永远不会成功。

sentences.en: Better to start off with a new leadership, perhaps a leadership that has no nuclear ambitions at all, and just change the equation in a more fundamental way.
sentences.zh: 最好从一个新的领导层开始，也许是一个根本没有核野心的领导层，从而以更根本的方式改变局面。

sentences.en: So, Mark, are we still on a collision course with Iran?
sentences.zh: 那么，马克，我们是否仍在与伊朗发生冲突的轨道上？

sentences.en: I'd say the more accurate way to put it is we're back on a collision course.
sentences.zh: 我认为更准确的说法是：我们又回到了冲突的轨道上。

sentences.en: We had been on a collision course with Iran for much of the last decade, and there was this brief period while the deal was in place
sentences.zh: 在过去十年的大部分时间里，我们一直处于与伊朗冲突的轨道上，而在协议生效的那段短暂时期，

sentences.en: where one could say that there was an understanding.
sentences.zh: 可以说双方达成了一种默契。

sentences.en: But we're now back in a very familiar dynamic.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在又回到了一个非常熟悉的动态中。

sentences.en: We continue to ratchet up the pressure.
sentences.zh: 我们继续加大压力。

sentences.en: We see acts of Iranian defiance, and it's very uncertain how the story plays out.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了伊朗的挑衅行为，而事态将如何发展，充满了极大的不确定性。

sentences.en: Mark, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: The Trump administration announced a new round of sanctions on Iranian steel, aluminum, copper, and iron, aimed at further squeezing its economy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府宣布对伊朗的钢铁、铝、铜和铁实施新一轮制裁，旨在进一步挤压其经济。

sentences.en: At the same time, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美国

sentences.en: said it would build up its military presence around Iran, including an anti-aircraft defense system, B-52 bombers, and a warship.
sentences.zh: 表示将加强在伊朗周边的军事存在，包括防空系统、B-52轰炸机和一艘军舰。

sentences.en: The military movements are based on U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些军事调动是基于美国的

sentences.en: intelligence, suggesting that Iran's government may try to provoke a conflict with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 情报，该情报显示伊朗政府可能试图挑起与美国的冲突，

sentences.en: to cement its hold on power, as the economic toll of U.S.
sentences.zh: 以巩固其权力，因为美国制裁带来的经济代价

sentences.en: sanctions continues to grow.
sentences.zh: 正在不断增加。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，去探索《时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The EU Parliament has only limited powers.
sentences.zh: 欧洲议会的权力非常有限。

sentences.en: It doesn't even propose the laws that it votes on.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不能提出自己投票表决的法律。

sentences.en: It's actually the unelected European Commission that comes up with those laws, which are then fleshed out by a different structure.
sentences.zh: 实际上，是由非民选的欧盟委员会提出这些法律，然后由不同的机构进行细化。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Russia appears to be engaging in a widespread campaign of misinformation aimed at influencing upcoming elections for the European Parliament,
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，俄罗斯似乎正在开展一场广泛的虚假信息运动，旨在影响即将举行的欧洲议会选举，

sentences.en: the legislative branch of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 即欧盟的立法机构。

sentences.en: Those elections, scheduled for late May, feature populist candidates who, if elected, would be hostile to the EU and sympathetic to Russia.
sentences.zh: 这些定于5月下旬举行的选举，候选人中包括民粹主义者，如果当选，他们将对欧盟持敌对态度，并同情俄罗斯。

sentences.en: The Russian campaign involves promoting right-wing parties in Italy and Germany and raising questions on TV networks like Russia Today
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的行动包括在意大利和德国推广右翼政党，并在“今日俄罗斯”等电视频道上提出质疑，

sentences.en: about the legitimacy of the European Parliament itself.
sentences.zh: 质疑欧洲议会本身的合法性。

sentences.en: Perhaps the real question is, does it matter who you vote for?
sentences.zh: 也许真正的问题是：你投给谁重要吗？

sentences.en: Because in reality, even a seismic shakeup at MEP level won't have any impact on the Commission nor the Council, where it seems the power base really lies.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，即使欧洲议会议员层面发生翻天覆地的变化，也不会对欧盟委员会或理事会产生任何影响，而那才是权力真正的根基所在。

sentences.en: The activity is the latest sign that despite indictments, sanctions, and expulsions,
sentences.zh: 这些活动是最新迹象，表明尽管有起诉、制裁和驱逐，

sentences.en: Russia remains committed to weakening Western institutions by deepening political divisions.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯仍致力于通过加深政治分歧来削弱西方机构。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方都可以收听。
